summary.intent: Plan and execute Phase 49 of cipher-box (shared-folder intra-share move + useFolderNavigation ECIES unwrap consolidation), then run the full PR-QA pipeline (simplify, security-review, CodeRabbit CLI) before pushing and opening a PR. Scope was expanded mid-planning to also include batch and drag-and-drop move in the shared view.
summary.outcome: Planning completed fully: 5 plans across 3 waves, all 6 requirements (including expanded batch+drag scope) covered, plan-checker passed after one revision round. Wave 1 execution completed (plans 49-01 SDK op + 49-02 useFolderNavigation unwrap). Wave 2 (49-03 web single-item move) was dispatched but the transcript ends before its result. PR-QA and PR creation not yet started.

repo: reencryptFileMetadataForFolderChange is fully key-agnostic (takes raw key bytes, no owner/recipient distinction) and is reusable verbatim for the shared-folder move case.
share_keys entries are keyed by itemId (file UUID), not parent folder — file keys do NOT need re-registration after a folder move.
File IPNS key for re-encryption must come from share_keys keyType:'file-ipns', not FilePointer.ipnsPrivateKeyEncrypted (owner-wrapped, recipient cannot decrypt it).
adoptSharedFolderResult must only be called once for the source result — calling it for the dest result would corrupt the rendered shared-folder view.
Collision policy in sdkCore.moveItem is to throw ('An item with this name already exists in destination'), not auto-rename.
@internal on ensureFolderLoaded is documentation-only; CipherBoxClient is already exported so it can be called directly from the web layer.
SharedFolderClient Pick allowlist (shared-folder-projection.ts:28-38) was missing moveInSharedFolder and enumerateSharedSubtree — these must be added for the web layer to access the new ops.
Private-vault batch move loops single-item client.moveItem via useFileBrowserActions → handleBatchMoveConfirm → useFolderMutations.handleMoveItems; no dedicated SDK batch method exists.
Private-vault drag move is wired in FileListItem (handleDragStart → handleDropOnFolder → moveItem/moveItems); shared view had none of this before Phase 49.
useSharedWriteOps.test.ts already exists — the REQ-3 unit test gap was fixable by extending it rather than creating a new file.
Intel API surface (regex extractor) was unpopulated and produced no output; RESEARCH.md is the authoritative symbol reference for planners.
The AI-SPEC gate false-positives on the keyword 'eval' appearing in e2e requirement text; zero actual AI content in this phase.

code.finding: reencryptFileMetadataForFolderChange signature is key-agnostic — takes raw sourceFolderKey/destFolderKey/fileIpnsPrivateKey, reusable for shared-folder move without modification.
sdkCore.moveItem throws 'An item with this name already exists in destination' on collision — propagates through runWrite → p.setError. No auto-rename needed.
SharedFolderClient Pick allowlist — only lists the 7 Phase 48 methods. moveInSharedFolder and enumerateSharedSubtree must be added here for Phase 49.
Key resolution: k.keyType === 'file' && k.itemId === item.id — parent folder is irrelevant, confirming file keys survive a folder move without re-registration.

workflow: Plan-checker running before execution caught a real blocker (REQ-3 had no web unit test, making verify vacuous) that would have created a verify-phase gap closure round later — worth the extra iteration.
Sequential execution without worktrees was chosen over parallel worktrees to avoid the merge-back cwd-drift and merge-base footguns documented in project memory, especially for an AFK autonomous run.

SDK dist staleness gotcha: after adding new public SDK methods (moveInSharedFolder, enumerateSharedSubtree), the SDK must be rebuilt before web-layer tsc — web checks the built dist, not source. New methods land in client.d.ts, not index.d.ts (which is a barrel re-export).
CodeRabbit CLI review belongs before PR creation; after PR creation CodeRabbit auto-posts a GitHub review and /resolve-pr-reviews handles that second pass.
Scope expansion (batch+drag) was folded into planning before the planner spawned — the lowest-cost moment to expand scope is after research confirms analogs exist and before the planner runs.

1Password-backed GPG signing and AFK autonomous sessions conflict — disabling commit.gpgsign locally for the session is the correct workaround, but the branch will need a signed rebase before merge since the repo enforces signed commits on PRs.

friction: Signed-commit conflict: global git config has commit.gpgsign=true (1Password signer), but the signer would wedge during AFK execution. Required disabling signing locally for the session, leaving the branch unmergeable until a signed rebase.
Plan-checker blocker on RESEARCH.md: two doc-formatting nits (missing resolution markers in open-questions section) had to be fixed manually before a clean checker pass.

Plan-checker blocker on REQ-3: the planner produced a plan whose verify step passed vacuously because no unit test was specified. Required a targeted planner revision to add a moveItemHandler test extending useSharedWriteOps.test.ts.

SDK dist staleness investigation: after wave 1, new SDK methods appeared absent from index.d.ts, triggering a multi-step investigation before confirming they were correctly in client.d.ts and accessible to consumers.
AI-SPEC gate false-positive on 'eval' keyword in e2e requirement text — required manual triage to confirm zero actual AI content before skipping.
